# NUA or IRA rollover: which leaves you with more after tax?

> Free NUA calculator: compare taking employer stock out of your 401(k) with net unrealized appreciation treatment against rolling everything to an IRA, with the 10% additional tax, holding period and a basis-share sensitivity table. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
